_comment: First-time tips. Each fires once per player profile (user://settings.cfg, not the save) the first time EventBus.tip_moment is sent with its `when`, and never while the game is playing itself. Text is what the README says about the same thing, cut down to one card.

tips.title: Watched ground
tips.text: A band is out on this ground. The red cells are what it can see, and they move as it patrols: step onto one and it fights you right there. Trees and rock block its view, and long grass hides you.

tips.title: The road
tips.text: WASD or the arrow keys walk the ground; walk off its edge to travel on. The map is in the journal (N). Esc opens the menu — How to Play is in there.

tips.title: Every step is time
tips.text: Each step moves the world's clock. Open gates spill, word of what you did travels, and the seasons turn whether you are ready or not.

tips.title: The wild is thickening
tips.text: Danger belongs to the place. Near an open gate bands stand thick on the ground; near a hearth the country goes quiet.

tips.title: A fight
tips.text: Fights run in real time and open paused. Space pauses and unpauses; give orders while paused. Right-click to move or attack, Q W E R for skills, and drag a box to pick several.

tips.title: Facing matters
tips.text: The wedge on a token shows where it looks. Side hits deal 1.1×, back hits 1.2×. Send someone round the side of a foe who is busy with somebody else.

tips.title: Falling is usually fatal
tips.text: A downed character has a few seconds for a friend to reach them — right-click them. If nobody does, they roll their graces: a charm carried, an ally still standing, a book read, the ground they fell on. If none land, they are gone for good.

tips.title: A place to stop
tips.text: Resting here patches everyone up. H hires whoever is drinking here, B buys the gear on the shelf, J reads the job board. The line at the bottom always says what you can do.

tips.title: Inside a gate
tips.text: Once you are in there is no walking out. Win a floor and every step is the next one, until the gate is beaten or you are. A gate left open too long breaks.

tips.title: A library
tips.text: Someone in the party reads what is on the shelf. Books grant knowledge, and knowledge left unused fades — the party screen (P) shows what is close to going.

tips.title: Home
tips.text: Nothing camps within sight of your own door, and sleeping here always patches the party up. U buys a better bed: its comfort becomes permanent extra HP.

tips.title: Level 2 is a choice
tips.text: Someone is ready to choose a path. Press P and pick their class from its card.

tips.title: The Tower
tips.text: A hundred floors, in chapters of five, each floor paying gold. What you win up here is only yours once you walk off its step — lose a floor and the hoard stays behind.

tips.title: An errand
tips.text: Its mark is on the map. Walk it yourself, or send a companion from the party screen's Practice page — they come back, or meet something on the road alone.

tips.title: The Adventurers Guild
tips.text: Y opens the Guild hall. Guild adventurers can muster beside you at a gate.

tips.title: The season has turned
tips.text: Seasons turn every 120 steps — Lesser Green, Green, Brown and Ice. The clover by the top bar says which one you are walking in.

tips.title: Let it play itself
tips.text: Q hands the run to the game — it walks, fights and answers for itself. T cycles the speed. Press Q again to take the party back, even mid-fight.
